'''Ryssk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was active during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Ryssk worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]], hunting [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were opposed to Mika's [[Spice/Legends|business]] operations.

==Biography==
{{RPG|''[[Tempest Feud]]''}}
The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] Ryssk lived and operated as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]]<ref name="TF" /> in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign.<ref name="CSWEts">{{CSWECite|III|230|tempest spice}}</ref> A capable [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who carried several weapons, Ryssk was hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] to pursue [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who had learned that Mika was controlling the distribution of [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The scout often appeared before the [[Bounty/Legends|targets]] while they were at a disadvantage, particularly when those spacers were already involved in combat with a third party.<ref name="TF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Skills and abilities==
Considered a capable scout, Ryssk was an apt pilot, [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]]. Ryssk was also proficient in stealth and demolitions. The scout was bilingual, capable of speaking [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]] as well as [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="TF" />

==Equipment==
Ryssk utilized a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] with a class 1x [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The Trandoshan was also equipped with a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]], an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion rifle]], and a selection of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] that included [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
While statistics for Ryssk appear in the first appendix of ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', an adventure published for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] in early [[2002]], Ryssk is not used during the normal outline of the adventure. Instead, Ryssk is only hired if the players deviate from the main outline of the adventure and determine that Mika is the spicelord manufacturing tempest prior to Act III. ''Tempest Feud'' is written to take place during any era.<ref name="TF" /> However, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published near the end of [[2008]], establishes that Mika Anjiliac Chiera produced tempest spice during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="CSWEts" />
